strings.name: Silvio Micali
strings.summary: At MIT, Micali studies cryptography, randomness and secure protocols. With Shafi Goldwasser and other collaborators, he advanced probabilistic encryption and zero-knowledge proofs, helping establish rigorous security definitions. He later founded Algorand to apply distributed-consensus research. In a 2025 interview he discussed Fiat Chain, a proposed public blockchain without a native cryptocurrency; its claims are distinct from his established research achievements.
